# The stub census's pinned list: every test the ts binding's ABI v2
# conformance leg (scripts/abi-v1/conformance/ts.sh) must pass, one per line, as
# scripts/abi-v1/stub_census.py names it (its file name, ::, its full name).
#
# The census refuses a run in which a test named here did not pass (a dropped
# test: skipped, ignored, failed or gone), and a run in which a test passed that
# no line names (an added or renamed test: the refusal prints the line to add).
# "[linux] " or "[darwin] " before a test: required on that OS only, because it
# runs on that OS only. Keep the lines sorted.
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library a call queued behind a full threadpool rejects at once on abort, and the library answers it at entry
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library a soak of racing aborts and returns: live handles back at baseline, and no fire ever reaches a freed token
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library an abort during the call: each of the six blocks in the stub, the abort rejects it, and the library answers CHS_CANCELED
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library an already-aborted signal rejects at once with CallCanceledError, and the library still answered CHS_CANCELED at entry with no output
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library cancel after the last check point
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library close() while a call is in flight: later calls are refused at once, the free waits for the call, and close does not cancel it
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library independent signals cancel only their own call
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library keep-alive: a queued call whose caller dropped every reference still reads its own body (and, with CHTYPES_TS_PLANTED_RED=1, the planted red: with it off, a use-after-free)
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library never aborted: the same answer as the synchronous call, with the token id in the options document
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library one signal across concurrent calls cancels all of them
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library the cancel id merges with the options the call already builds, and replaces a cancel key in insertOptionsExtra
cancel.test.ts :: cancelable async calls over the stub library with no signal: no token is made and no extra call, and the options document is the synchronous one
